result.reason: The redline minimally extends the unified warranty period from 60 to 90 days and removes the calendar cutoff, thereby meeting the fallback software and services durations while preserving the operative correction, replacement, and refund remedy structure. It does not meet the preferred position because it lacks professional-and-workmanlike and legal-compliance warranties, provides only 90 rather than 12 months for software, and limits the malicious-code warranty to willfully introduced code of specified types.
